entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH

For the Petitioner : Mr. Ashish Jha, Advocate For the State : Mr. Rajendra Ram Ravi Das, A.P.P  --------
04/ Dated 21.06.2023  Heard the parties.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Barkagaon P.S. Case No. 0268 of 2021,
for the offences under Sections 498A, 328, 304-B, 313 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 / 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Hazaribag.
It was submitted that petitioner is the father-in-law of the deceased Lalita Devi.

It was further submitted that the husband of the deceased namely Rajesh Kumar and her mother-in-law namely Dhali Devi have been acquitted by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-VI, Hazaribag in S.T.
No.169/2022 on the ground that the informant and other witnesses have been declared hostile.
Supplementary affidavit has been filed, bringing on record the fact that no process under Section 82 Cr.P.C has been issued to procure the attendance of the petitioner.
Considering the entire facts of this case; I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Hazaribag, in connection with Barkagaon P.S.
Case No. 0268 of 2021, subject to the the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
BS/ (Ambuj Nath, J.)
